answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the horizon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the violet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
